---
description: Tab content wrapper
title: Tab
---
`bcgov-tab` wraps content in a shadow-DOM host with a default slot. It does not provide tab selection, keyboard navigation, or tab semantics.

## Example

```html
<bcgov-tab>
  <h2>Panel content</h2>
  <p>Content supplied by the consumer.</p>
</bcgov-tab>
```
